title: Graph Metanetworks for Transformer Based Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18471v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Weight-space learning treats the weights of neural networks as data, processed by other models called metanetworks. A key challenge is that different weights can realize the same function, related by a group of symmetries the metanetwork should respect. While symmetry-aware metanetworks for simple architectures such as MLPs are well developed, a comprehensive treatment of transformers, and in particular transformer-based language models, is still missing. Importantly, their weight space has a richer symmetry group: beyond neuron permutations, attention introduces continuous general-linear symmetries of the attention matrices and permutations of entire heads. Existing methods for transformer weights either capture only part of these symmetries or are restricted to a single, fixed architecture, and none accounts for language-model-specific components such as the token embeddings. tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于图元网络的方法，全面捕捉Transformer语言模型权重空间中的丰富对称性（包括神经元置换、注意力矩阵的连续一般线性对称性及注意力头置换），并处理词元嵌入等语言模型特有组件。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a graph metanetwork-based approach that comprehensively captures the rich symmetry group of transformer-based language model weight spaces—including neuron permutations, continuous general-linear symmetries of attention matrices, and head permutations—while accounting for language-model-specific components such as token embeddings.
